text: In IQ-TREE2, an ultrafast bootstrap (UFBoot) value of ≥95% is considered roughly comparable in reliability to what standard nonparametric bootstrap value?
explanation: Ultrafast bootstrap corrects for the bias that makes standard bootstrap conservative, so a UFBoot value of ≥95% is roughly equivalent in reliability to a standard nonparametric bootstrap value of ≥70%, the classic 'reasonably supported' threshold. The other options either overstate (≥90%, ≥99%) or understate (≥50%) the correspondence given in the standard guidance for interpreting UFBoot alongside classical bootstrap.
